## HEADLINE
Software Engineer | Functional programming and distributed systems

## ABOUT
Software engineer solving problems with functional programming and reactive systems. Four years writing Haskell in production at NoRedInk, and before that Clojure on Nubank's lending infrastructure. Most of my career has been functional programming at companies running it at scale.

Title: Software Engineer
Dates: April 2022 - Present
Location: Remote

Education software. Helped create two new products that made the software work for 3rd to 5th graders, and led two projects on the introduction and tutorial flows for assignments, which meant remodelling parts of both frontend and backend to keep them flexible.

• Backend: Writing and architecting features in Haskell and Ruby on Rails, over Postgres and MySQL.
• Frontend: Architecting pages needing rich text editing, animation and non-trivial state, in Elm.

• Culture: Organise and run the company Haskell book club.

### Nubank
Title: Senior Software Engineer
Dates: July 2019 - April 2022
Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Engineer on the lending team, developing and leading features to scale the product. Built core services across the lending infrastructure: account management, renegotiation, issuance, payments, risk management and dynamic underwriting.

• Backend: Microservices in Clojure with Kafka, Datomic, Kubernetes, Tekton, GraphQL and AWS; contributed to Nubank's shared Clojure libraries.
• Ops: Monitoring, debugging, right-sizing and alerting with Splunk, Prometheus and Grafana. Defined the team's stability index metrics.
• Mobile: Back-end driven architecture for Flutter and React Native clients over GraphQL.
• Web: Internal backoffice tooling in ClojureScript, Pathom, Fulcro and TypeScript.
• Data: Monitoring dashboards and KPIs with Looker, Databricks and BigQuery.
• Leadership: Led projects using customer data for real-time risk analysis: drove the architecture decisions, wrote the tech assessments and set expectations with stakeholders.

Skills: Clojure, ClojureScript, Kafka, Datomic, Kubernetes, GraphQL, AWS, Prometheus
